title: Token-pool coalescer and yellowzone throttling playbook for KV cache fragmentation
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Background: We observe increased GPU memory fragmentation in long-running inference nodes where continuous batching + unpredictable token distributions lead to many small KV entries and 'holes' in the GPU slab allocator. This increases OOM events and reduces effective capacity for KV state, forcing smaller batch sizes or model fallbacks. Objective: Define and implement a conservative allocation and background coalescing strategy ("token-pool coalescer") combined with a runbook and automated admission-control "yellowzone" throttling policy that prevents catastrophic fragmentation while preserving latency SLOs and batching throughput. Scope: Implementation touches GPU KV allocation layer, background compactor, admission control in router, and Console telemetry/alerts. Non-goals: Full global recompact that requires model reloads; any solution that blocks inference for >1s at tail latency is unacceptable.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New fragmentation telemetry available: fragmentation_ratio, movable_chunks, avg_hole_size, compactor_throughput
2) Token-pool coalescer implemented with configurable windowing and age/usage heuristics; no regression in median latency (<5% change) in canary experiments
3) Yellowzone throttle policy enforces reduced admission rate when fragmentation_ratio > 0.36 and movable_chunks > 1024, with automatic recovery once metrics below thresholds
4) End-to-end integration test that simulates continuous batching workload and demonstrates 40% reduction in fragmentation growth over 24h compared to baseline
5) Runbook documented in Confluence and rollout plan with canary -> gradual -> full cluster phases
implementation_steps: Design & spec: finalize coalescer algorithm and yellowzone thresholds with SRE and runtime team
Telemetry: add fragmentation metrics and expose in Console; add grafana dashboard and alert rules
Allocator changes: add soft-allocation tagging to allow adjacent KV entries to be coalesced by age/usage buckets
Coalescer: implement background coalescer that performs in-place contiguous merges on GPU where possible, and copies+rewrites otherwise; rate-limited by GPU util and latency headroom
Admission control: implement yellowzone throttling in router; integrate with batching controller to reduce batch sizes gradually when in yellowzone
Benchmarks: run microbenchmarks and end-to-end load tests; measure latency P50/P95/P99 and fragmentation metrics
Rollout: deploy to 10% canary, monitor for 48h, then 50% for 72h, then full rollout
Docs & runbook: publish Confluence doc, update runbooks for incident response and emergency disable flag
